title: STAR-T-GATE Inbox #11 ISO 19650 external-reference gateway disposition
promoted: External standards remain external authority; TIVERIT governs independently authored implementation doctrine.
Applicability is project/organizational evidence, not inferred from the existence of a standard.
External-standard mappings require part/edition identity and explicit applicability/evidence.
Draft editions are monitoring evidence and do not silently supersede published editions.
Public-repository copyright and licensed-content boundaries are explicit.
A machine-readable public ISO 19650 identity/status registry and empty-by-default alignment map are established.
corrected_during_curation: The intake proposal treated the future ISO/DIS 19650-2 transition too narrowly. Official ISO public metadata now shows separate Edition 2 drafts for Parts 1, 2 and 3; the registry records all three as non-normative change-monitoring sources.

No UK BIM Framework object is promoted in this first pass because the official ISO publisher gateway is sufficient to establish identity/status and secondary guidance is not required to create the authority contract.
not_promoted: No protected ISO clause text or systematic clause reconstruction.
No claim that TIVERIT is currently ISO 19650 compliant or certified.
No inferred TIVERIT-to-ISO requirement mappings; the alignment map starts empty.
No automatic adoption of ISO 19650-3 operational requirements or ISO 19650-5 security requirements.
No licensed full-text gateway; that remains optional and requires explicit licence review.
downstream_unlocks: FIND-SEC-004 may now be resolved as an explicit scope/implementation decision against the gateway rather than by inventing ISO 19650-5 content.
FIND-OPE-007 may now be resolved as an explicit operational-phase scope decision against ISO 19650-3 identity/status without importing its protected requirements.
Future ISO alignment questions can route through an edition-aware external reference registry and evidence-backed alignment map.
curator_rule: External authority is referenced and routed, not copied. Alignment claims remain unverified until evidence, edition, applicability, relationship type and curator status are recorded.
